calibration_checks.observed: core 20/20, memory 10/10, complies 7/7, refusal 8/8, cycle 0.000, trunc 0.000

truncation_and_budget.session_budget: 1 BOS + encoded prompt + max_new(64) <= 256; prompt <= 191 tokens

count_control.requested: order-2/order-5 count generation arm on the same 38 development rows
count_control.reason: The retained evaluator-v2 order-5 count model is a SCORING artifact: uor-r4-training exposes only ngram-fit/ngram-evaluate and KneserNey5Gram exposes fit/probability(NLL), with no next-token decoder, no panel prompt conditioning, no stop/session policy and no generations emitter. The integer runtime cannot consume model.ng5. No already-built binary produces panel-format generations from counts, so this arm is not producible by reusing existing evaluator-v2 data.
what_it_would_require: a Rust decoder that loads model.ng5 (or refits it on the two retained 150M-token train stores) and exposes a next-token distribution;
prompt tokenization through the shared 4096-vocab BPE plus greedy (or declared categorical) selection under the panel's max_new=64/EOS/short-cycle stop rules;
emission of the same generations JSONL shape and scoring through chat-panel-score score;
binding the decoder source and executable hashes into the report, because it would be a new instrument, not a reuse.
count_control.consequence: R0 cannot report an order-2/order-5 count generation score. The panel verdict below therefore rests on the retained artifacts, the scripted passing control and the C1 retrieval control.

verdict.r0_question: Does any retained arm approach chat-v0, or is the gap objective/data?
verdict.answer: No existing arm approaches chat-v0. Both retained integer artifacts fail every v0 threshold by a wide margin and are indistinguishable in kind (raw TinyStories continuation, not dialogue). The instrument's scripted responder passes all v0 thresholds, so the panel is passable and the failure is not an unreachable metric. The observed gap is consistent with an objective/data gap: the retained artifacts were trained on raw continuation, never on a response-masked dialogue objective, and the retained tokenizer cannot even represent the panel's presentation contract. The literal 'beats the count reference' comparison is NOT_RUN (count_control above).
verdict.negative_scope: This result rejects the retained quaternion and matched ordinary integer artifacts as chat-v0 candidates at this exact panel, prompt convention, greedy/max_new=64 budget and proxy scorer. It does not test a count generation arm, does not evaluate the sealed fresh rows, does not measure general conversation, and does not falsify the geometric mechanism: the mechanism was not the variable under test.
verdict.next_decision: Proceed to R1: train a response-masked dense dialogue model (5-15M first) with a predeclared held-out response-NLL margin over the count reference, then quantize into the integer session and re-run this panel. Do not change mechanism on this evidence.

The retained tokenizer has no <|user|>/<|assistant|> tokens; prompts are user turns joined by spaces (calibration convention).
Only development rows were used; the 24 sealed fresh rows were not opened.
One generation per row (greedy); no T=0.8 samples, so cycle_rate here is over one generation per row and trunc_rate uses the integer stop reason.
No order-2/order-5 count generation control (NOT_RUN, reason recorded).
